source:
@@U00945@@
Here it’s bright,
There brighter to sight.
I’m alive! Watch out!
Take care, my boy!
This is no toy!
It’s made of clay
And will crumble away!

@@U00947@@
Why the sieve?

@@U00949@@
(Taking it down.)

@@U00950@@
If you were a thief,
I could tell without grief.
(He scampers over to the FEMALE MONKEY and makes
her look through it.)
See through the sieve!
You know the thief well,
Though his name you wont tell!

@@U00952@@
(Going to the fire.)

@@U00953@@
And this pot?

@@U00955@@
The crack-brained sot
Knows not the pot,
Knows not the kettle!

@@U00957@@
Discourteous beasts!

@@U00959@@
Here, take this whisk!
Sit down on the settle!
(He makes 梅菲斯特 sit down. 浮士德 in the meantime
has been standing in front of a mirror, now approaching it, now
drawing back.)
translation:
@@U00945@@
这里天亮了，
那里更明亮。
我还活着！当心！
保重，我的孩子！
这不是玩具！
它是用粘土做的
并且会崩溃！

@@U00947@@
为什么要用筛子？

@@U00949@@
（把它拿下来。）

@@U00950@@
如果你是小偷，
我可以毫不悲伤地告诉你。
（他跑向母猴并做出
她看过去。）
透过筛子看！
你很了解小偷，
虽然他的名字你不会告诉！

@@U00952@@
（走向火边。）

@@U00953@@
还有这个锅？

@@U00955@@
脑子有问题的傻瓜
不识锅，
不认识水壶！

@@U00957@@
无礼的畜生！

@@U00959@@
来，拿着这个搅拌器！
坐下来吧！
（他让梅菲斯特坐下。同时浮士德
一直站在镜子前，现在靠近它，现在
退后。）
